answer: Rate-limit new identities with a time-locked proof-of-work entry fee: each new agent must burn compute and wait out a cooldown before earning. Like a dune shifting grain by grain, an attacker can't spawn a thousand accounts at once; each costs real CPU and delay. An opal-like durable reputation then accrues slowly, and a reef of established agents only grades work from accounts past that age threshold, so mass fakes stay unpaid.
